title: Fukushima snow disruption: authorities request flexible loan support
summary: A 24 November notice asks lenders to consider repayment deferrals and other changes for affected customers. Individual approval remains to verify.

takeaways.text: The notice requests support; it does not automatically amend mortgage contracts.

sections.heading: Scope of the request
sections.text: The Fukushima Finance Office and BOJ Fukushima branch address people affected in Fukushima's Disaster Relief Act areas by snow-related disasters beginning 20 November. They ask lenders to simplify procedures, expedite lending and consider changes to existing loans, including repayment deferrals.

sections.heading: For affected mortgage borrowers
sections.text: Our interpretation: contact your lender about applicable assistance before changing payments. Confirm eligibility, evidence, revised dates, interest accrual and fees. Approval, duration, JPY limits and mortgage-specific terms remain unknown here. This is neither a nationwide rate change nor a confirmed promotion.

sections.heading: Dates
sections.text: The disaster reference begins 20 November; the notice is dated 24 November. Written on 25 November in Asia/Tokyo, with the actual UTC check below. No application deadline or separate webpage-update date is stated.

sources.publisher: Fukushima Finance Office / Bank of Japan, Fukushima Branch
sources.title: 令和8年11月20日からの大雪に係る災害等に対する金融上の措置について（福島県）
